description: Column contract for points.csv and the UE DataTable row struct FWorldCompilerPoint. Order is fixed. Types are UE property types for the row struct; the CSV header uses these names verbatim.

columns.name: mesh
columns.note: soft object path; PCGMeshSelectorByAttribute reads it

columns.name: material
columns.note: soft object path of the band MI; material override by attribute (petal slot = index 1 when StemMaterial is present)

columns.name: StemMaterial
columns.note: soft object path for slot 0 (stem/leaf); empty when the species has one material slot

columns.name: Position
columns.note: mirror of x,y,z; Load Data Table maps it to $Position

columns.name: Scale3D
columns.note: uniform scale as a vector; maps to $Scale. Named Scale3D because FNames are case-insensitive and 'Scale' collides with 'scale'.

naming_rule: No two columns may differ only by letter case (UE FName comparison is case-insensitive; the DataTable would silently alias them).
row_struct_note: User Defined Struct created once via Monolith blueprint.create_user_defined_struct; Monolith type strings are float/int/name/string/struct:Vector/struct:Rotator (bare 'Vector' silently falls back to bool). CSV import uses the first column as the row name, so world_compiler_ue.py prepends a '---' column = 'p<point_id>'.
